geometry.kind: set of whole VEP-atlas regions (region rule, not a patient-space volume)
geometry.ez_estimate_rule: EZ estimate from the P2 ModelBundle named in the simulation task: top-1 = region with highest posterior median (MAP ensemble: median over converged optima) x0; EZ set = regions with P(x0 > threshold) > 0.5 (MAP ensemble: fraction of optima > 0.5), threshold as defined in the ModelBundle

physical_mapping.model_nodes: VEP atlas regions (162-node P2 connectome); whole-region removal
physical_mapping.implementation_primary: (a) ablation: x0 of removed regions set to the healthy value -3.0 in the full SpatEpiStim model
physical_mapping.implementation_secondary: (b) disconnection: SC rows and columns of removed regions set to 0

constraints.eloquent_cortex: not_reported (virtual patient; no functional mapping) - not applied
constraints.contact_positions: reported_absent (no MRI / electrode coordinates, A0010); contacts are identified only by bipolar channel name and gain row
constraints.reserved_outcomes: not used; candidates are rules applied to the fitted EZ estimate only
constraints.interpretation: virtual intervention on a model; research evidence, not a clinical recommendation
constraints.tissue_removed: number of whole regions removed is reported as the cost objective

feasibility_verdict: feasible_in_silico (model-level only; surgical feasibility not assessable without anatomy)
status_note: rule committed before any P2 model existed (T0015); concrete regions are derived in the simulation task and recorded there
